answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 71 aliases, and each one needs its own funded fable account. Deposits are visible in kernel, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 51% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 3199 identities would post 4015 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
